scope.fixture_source: fixtures.py; deterministic arithmetic and string templates; no random generator
scope.fixture_design_limit: Inputs deliberately contain repeated synthetic padding and structure to exercise compression; these fixtures may overstate savings on less-repetitive inputs.
scope.input_boundary: obviously synthetic tool-output text only; no prompt text, secrets, personal data, private paths, or production data

environment.trafilatura: 2.3.1 (pinned by the reused environment lock; not imported)
environment.lockfile_hash_scope: 108 entries including the virtual local project entry; downloadable dependency artifacts have hashes, while the virtual local project entry does not have an artifact hash.

token_metrics.headroom: Headroom result tokens_before, tokens_after, tokens_saved, and compression_ratio; v0.40.0 defines ratio as tokens_saved divided by tokens_before
token_metrics.independent_count: tiktoken 0.14.0 get_encoding('o200k_base') over compact JSON serialization of the complete message list
token_metrics.billing_limit: Neither count includes provider-side message framing or establishes billed tokens or provider savings

gold_marker_oracle.method: count exact predetermined synthetic marker substrings in serialized messages before and after compression
gold_marker_oracle.observed: 25 of 25 markers found after compression across all 15 trials
gold_marker_oracle.aggregate_rule: The overall percentage is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the 15 per-trial Headroom ratios.
gold_marker_oracle.establishes: only exact string presence for these known synthetic markers
does_not_establish: retention of unmarked facts or structure

observed_runtime_symptom.classification: host/runtime selection, not a confirmed software defect
observed_runtime_symptom.detail: Headroom reported pure-Python content detection because native Magika/ONNX detection is unsafe by default on Windows.
observed_runtime_symptom.cross_platform_caveat: A host that selects a different detector backend may produce different metrics.

primary_sources.establishes: the tagged project release and its release notes
primary_sources.does_not_establish: independent validation of compression quality, semantic retention, or provider savings

primary_sources.establishes: the public compress() API, configuration fields, result metrics, and documented compression-ratio definition
primary_sources.does_not_establish: that this benchmark's input facts are semantically retained beyond the explicitly measured marker oracle

primary_sources.establishes: the vendor's description of its compression pipeline
primary_sources.does_not_establish: an independent audit of implementation behavior or output quality

primary_sources.establishes: published package release metadata and artifact hashes
primary_sources.does_not_establish: equivalence to any provider's billed-token accounting

primary_sources.establishes: the gpt-4o to o200k_base model-tokenizer mapping in that tagged source
primary_sources.does_not_establish: Headroom's internal token count is identical to a provider's request accounting

primary_sources.establishes: the package's explicit get_encoding() usage pattern
primary_sources.does_not_establish: billing semantics or provider-side message framing

reproduction.command: uv sync --locked --python 3.13.16 && uv run --locked python run_benchmark.py --output-dir output
outputs: output/trial-details.jsonl (full synthetic inputs and compressed outputs)
